summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues his commentary on Al-Wajeez, focusing on the chapter regarding menstruation (al-hayd) and postpartum bleeding (nifas) in the book of purification. He emphasizes the importance of this knowledge for all Muslims, as everyone has mothers, daughters, and sisters who need to understand these rulings. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains that menstruation and postpartum bleeding, while known experiences, are defined in later fiqh books for clarity. He clarifies that menstruation has no fixed time limit and varies between women, while postpartum bleeding has a maximum duration of 40 days based on the hadith of Umm Salamah. Sh. Ali Mashhour notes that after 40 days, any continued bleeding is no longer legislatively considered postpartum, even if it may be medically classified as such.
